title: KEYLESS
features:
Auto Pickup Section
AUTO PICKUP - Toggle ON/OFF for automatic item collection

PICKUP RADIUS - Adjustable range: 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 (default 15)

PICKUP MODE - Switch between "ALL ITEMS" or "FILTERED" mode

Kill Aura Section
KILL AURA - Toggle automated combat ON/OFF

AUTO EQUIP - Automatically equips best weapon from backpack

EXTENDED RANGE - Increases attack detection range

PRIORITY - Cycle through targeting modes: NEAREST → LOWEST HP → HIGHEST HP

SHOW INDICATOR - Toggle visual line/circle on current target

ESP Section
ITEM ESP - Toggle floating nametags above dropped items

PLAYER ESP - Toggle purple highlights + distance nametags on other players

Utility Section
INSTANT INTERACT - Removes hold time and line-of-sight requirements for interactions

INF JUMP - Toggle infinite jumping ON/OFF
